Bruce Springsteen ‘heartbroken’ as rock critic Dave Marsh dies at 76
articles.description: Music writer Dave Marsh, who shaped Bruce Springsteen's public story, has died at seventy-six. His writing extended beyond Springsteen to cover rock music history and other artists. Marsh's legacy includes his outspoken and passionate documentation of American rock music.
